_meta.title: 1 Peter — key verses per chapter (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from each of the 5 chapters of 1 Peter. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 60 1 Peter); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: several key verses per chapter (~2-3, scaled to chapter substance)
_meta.keying: book + chapter + citation; multiple records per chapter
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: KJV New Testament renders the divine name as 'Lord'/'God' (no tetragrammaton); text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
verses.plain: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

verses.text: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
verses.plain: so that the tested genuineness of your faith — more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire — may result in praise, glory, and honor when Jesus Christ is revealed.

verses.text: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
verses.plain: Though you have not seen him, you love him; and even though you don't see him now, you believe in him and are filled with an inexpressible and glorious joy,

verses.text: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
verses.plain: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's special possession — so that you may declare the praises of him who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light.

verses.text: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
verses.plain: He himself bore our sins in his body on the cross, so that we might die to sin and live for righteousness; by his wounds you have been healed.

verses.text: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
verses.plain: But in your hearts honor Christ as Lord. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope you have — but do so with gentleness and respect.

verses.text: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
verses.plain: For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit.

verses.text: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
verses.plain: Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.

verses.text: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
verses.plain: Each of you should use whatever gift you have received to serve others, as faithful stewards of God's grace in its various forms.

verses.text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
verses.plain: Humble yourselves, then, under God's mighty hand, so that he may lift you up in due time.

verses.text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
verses.plain: Cast all your anxiety on him, because he cares for you.

verses.text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
verses.plain: Be alert and clear-minded. Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, looking for someone to devour.
